data.name: Piano Glow
data.detailed_description:
PianoGlow is a piano game featuring:

  • Multiplayer

    • Show-off your piano skills & listen to others around the globe.

    • Queue-based mode to take turns playing piano.

    • Several multiplayer modes, including queue, guess drawing (draw while playing piano), guess songs (players play a song and guess each other's song).

    • In-game currency, earned via daily rewards, quests and tipping other players.

    • Global and private chatrooms. Voice chat and friend/block lists.

    • Offline and single-player mode.

  • Works with both QWERTY keyboard, a real digital piano or MIDI controllers

    • Play any music or song with a QWERTY keyboard (laptop/computer).

    • Or connect to a real digital piano or MIDI controller via USB-B (any song works with any size keyboard, even as small as 25, since the PianoGlow app can auto-convert any MIDI or song to a smaller one).

    • Velocity integration with Wooting Analog QWERTY keyboards so that you can play with dynamics on the computer keyboard (loud & soft).

    • Record & load MIDI files (live play or render as video from within the app).

  • Training modes & tools

    • Ear training, rhythm, falling notes, chord, scales, arpeggios & sheet music game modes.

    • Customizable setting in many training modes to auto-pause until you hit the next correct note/chord (auto-pause on by default).

    • Tracks stats and shows wrong answers more often to focus on your weaknesses. Unlock achievements!

    • Detailed calendar that shows exactly how much you practiced each day and month.

    • AI-based fingering, help determine which fingers to use on any MIDI file or song.

    • AI-based converter that adjusts any MIDI/MusicXML or song to fit into a smaller piano/keyboard.

    • Interactive Circle-of-Fifths cheat sheet - clicking shows the common chord triads, key signature and the 7th chords.

    • Automated Chord Name Identifier & Intervals when you play any chord on the piano.

    • Lighted Keyboards - lights up the indicators on your MIDI keyboard in falling notes.

    • Upload any MIDI or MusicXML file to practice music with, and it will show both Falling Notes and Sheet Music notation.

    • Set any custom time-range and loop practice it. It will remember the time-range for when you re-visit the song.

    • MIDI Editor - create new songs and edit your performances/recordings.

  • Customizable themes

    • Stunning visuals & particle effects that move in sync with the tempo of your playing.

    • Upload video files as the background.

    • 3D camera customization - slant/rotate your 3D piano and effects however you see wish.

  • QWERTY features

    • Direct integration of vp-sheets.arijan.dev and Trellos (library of 50,000+ QWERTY songs) within the app and shares the same controls as most other virtual piano games.

    • Auto-play QWERTY sheet music (semi-auto included).

    • Typing game modes, where falling notes (and sheet music based notation) are also shown with QWERTY notes.

    • Velocity settings such as predictive or random velocity, adjust velocity curve and more.

    • Transpose detection - press TAB to auto-transpose to the next auto-detected transpose in QWERTY sheets, or hold transpose and press a number to manually jump to a specific transpose.

    • In-game notepad for you to load or edit QWERTY sheets, with transpose tools and OCR.

    • Convert MIDI files to QWERTY.

  • Customizable Audio

    • Customizable reverb & equalizer audio effects.

    • Upload custom SoundFont (.sf2, .sf3) files, VST3 support and ASIO support.

    • Load multiple SoundFonts simultaneously (e.g. one for left-hand vs right-hand).

    • Create your own SoundFonts (by loading an MP3 or WAV and it will let you export a SoundFont file)!

  • Community

    • Discord community server, chat and share tips about piano.

    • Dedicated website and regular social media content.

    • Pay once and it's for a lifetime: all updates in the future will be free as part of your one-time purchase (instead of DLCs), with a heavy focus on user-feedback as seen on the news.

data.short_description: Piano in online multiplayer lobbies, with leaderboards, gamified training modes (ear, sheet, rhythm and falling notes). Play any song using either a QWERTY computer/laptop keyboard or a piano.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Arabic*, Indonesian*, Japanese*, Korean*, Polish*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Spanish - Latin America*, Turkish*, Ukrainian*, Bangla*, Hindi*
*languages with full audio support
data.reviews:
“I'm actually a little addicted to this game. I love the gamified elements. I'm excited to come home and load it up every day. Its really made learning easy and effective with none of the chores that typically come with practicing.”
Ayien

“best piano app I've tried. The people I've met in the multiplayer game mode made playing piano more fun!”
Sxronxploits

“omg my mind is scrambled in a good way I am actually learning by Ear, I have never learned classic sheet music stuff until now I am remembering both types of visual learnings! Best game I played this year so far maybe in forever haha I will keep updating my review sometime”
Shevarr

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) and Windows 10
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, DX12 capable
  • Storage: 800 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent (Apple M1 or later for Apple Silicon Macs)
  • Memory: 2000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
